label: Lembert Studio Program · 2027
title: A Year of Increase
opening: Imagine a year where by the end of it you didn't get older, less energy and closer to death, but instead you increased life. Increasing wealth, your capacity to experience life, to be and feel free, to create massive results in all areas of life, without sacrificing fun, time, joy, freedom.

Imagine looking back at a year and being in awe of what happened out of you choosing to play the impossible game — the game of sacrificing the idea of compromise, limit, sacrifice, lack, concern and reasonableness, and instead chose to go all in on increasing all that you want with 0 justification.
questions: Have you ever dared to want what you want fully and hold it as possible for longer than a day?

What would happen if you spend a year with a group of people who are all playing this game? Who are all willing to let go of the smallness of their minds, all willing to see failure as simply one more iteration in the joyful game of creating an increase in LIFE?
callToQuestion: Are you willing to play this game?
qualifications: You have to run a business which is your full time occupation. You are willing to take action that will lead to increase in income, freedom, health, fun and overall aliveness.
I repeat: you have to be willing to have success! This might sound funny, but not everyone is.
You need to be willing to bring the truth to a room of people all committed to playing the game of increase themselves. The impossible game of ending up with more life as time passes.
notForLabel: This is not for you if
notFor: you are looking for a list of actions, a guru or permission
you want results without being willing to change
you need it to be reasonable before you say yes
you want to argue for the limitations of your life more than for its possibility
closing: If something in you resonates, even if you can't justify wanting this — let's talk.
